localBrowserChecks.skipReason: Real BGE inference runs once on desktop, not again in the mobile viewport

coreFlows.scope: DOCX parsing and backups, research notes, comparisons and evidence maps; desktop and simulated mobile layout

scenarios: Prepare complete package from public origin
Collect evidence and persist a note
Reload without network and restore the note
Open the exact original-text highlight without fabricating a Word page

initialAttempt.resolution: Repeat core scenarios separately; repeat the actual public download with a 240-second limit. The download completed after 93 seconds and the full offline Word flow then passed. No application network behavior was changed.

limits: Desktop Chrome and a simulated mobile viewport, not real Android or iOS devices
DOCX extraction does not preserve the original layout or physical pages
Public download time depends on network conditions; one successful run is not a universal access guarantee
